verseText: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
meaning: God's love is steadfast: faithful and never-stopping. His mercy (love we don't deserve) will never, ever stop.

recall.question: What does this verse tell us about God's mercies?
choices: There is a limited supply of them

meaning.question: Mercy means showing kindness and forgiveness even when someone doesn't deserve it. What does God's never-ending mercy teach us about Him?
choices: His love for us never ends
He loves us only when we love him
He stops loving us when we fail

application.prompt: Even when we mess up, God's mercy never runs out! His love remains faithful through our hardest days. How could remembering God's mercy change the way you respond after you've sinned?
